mapper.select: SELECT a.order_id,a.order_line_id,i.product_id,a.warehouse_id,a.quantity, a.gross_amount,a.discount_amount,a.freight_amount FROM order_warehouse_amounts a JOIN order_items i ON i.id=a.order_line_id WHERE a.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY a.order_line_id,a.warehouse_id

SELECT p.package_id,p.warehouse_id,l.order_line_id,l.quantity FROM order_package_allocations p JOIN order_package_lines l ON l.package_id=p.package_id WHERE p.order_id=#{orderId} AND p.posted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.posted_at,p.package_id,l.order_line_id
